headline_stat.name: Replay mean|r| POST vs PRE (Mann-Whitney)
headline_stat.value: 0.375 vs 0.362, p=0.0037; POST vs own shuffle p=0.120

stated_limitation: The effect size is modest and the population-level rank correlation is only slightly above a cell-identity-shuffled null, which is expected: rank-order correlation on raw spike times is a coarser readout of replay content than full Bayesian place-field decoding, and only a minority of SWRs are expected to reflect a clean, complete replay of a single trajectory.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 (sub-Achilles) is the canonical dataset for sharp-wave ripples and replay, with PRE/POST sleep bracketing track running.
justification.handling: Real LFP and spikes streamed via remfile, correct 1250 Hz sampling, proper epoch and Non-REM state restriction, and excitatory-cell filtering, all explicit and defensible.
justification.analysis: Standard SWR detection, Skaggs-info directional place fields, and rank-order replay scoring with a cell-identity shuffle null are all appropriate and correctly computed.
justification.correctness: Every reported number reproduces exactly from run.log, figures and text are internally consistent, and both the Mann-Whitney and shuffle tests are correctly executed.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show ripples, plausible ripple stats, cleanly tiled place fields, honestly overlapping replay distributions, and an example event labeled as high-scoring rather than typical.
justification.honesty: The write-up transparently reports the non-significant shuffle control and characterizes the replay effect as modest, though it leans on the n-inflated PRE-vs-POST comparison as the 'significant' headline and softly frames the failed replay control as 'expected.'
justification.verdict: Rigorous, honestly reported work whose SWR and place-field results are strong and whose weak replay claim is fairly caveated; accept with revision to sharpen the shuffle-control framing and add a single-session caveat.
